title: Vanilla Panna Cotta with Raspberry Sauce
summary: A silky Italian-style vanilla cream dessert topped with a bright raspberry sauce. Light, rich and elegant, it’s ideal for ending a dinner party or make-ahead dessert night.
steps: Make the raspberry sauce first: put the raspberries, sugar, lemon juice and water in a small pan and cook over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the berries break down and the sauce looks glossy.
Press the sauce through a sieve if you want it smooth, then set aside to cool.
For the panna cotta, whisk the cornstarch with a splash of the milk until smooth.
Pour the remaining milk, double cream, sugar, vanilla extract and a pinch of salt into a saucepan and warm over medium heat until steaming, but do not let it boil.
Whisk in the cornstarch mixture and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until slightly thickened and silky.
Divide the mixture between 4 glasses or ramekins and chill for at least 2 hours, or until set and lightly wobbling.
Spoon the cooled raspberry sauce over the top just before serving.
